## Overview
| Aspect | Details |
|--------|---------|
| **Purpose** | Generate PDF album pages from `.album` definition files |
| **Tech Stack** | .NET 10, PDFsharp 6.x, xUnit + NSubstitute |
| **Input** | `.album` (XML/JSON/YAML), `.style`, images, fonts |
| **Output** | PDF with summary page + album pages |

## Folder Structure
```
src/MyAlbum/
├── Definition/    # Parsed model classes
├── Layout/        # Computed model classes
├── Parsing/       # Format detection + parsers (XML, JSON, YAML)
├── Styles/        # StyleSheet, StyleResolver, StyleLoader
├── Rendering/     # PdfRenderer + ElementRenderers
├── Resources/     # Font/Image loaders
└── Cli/           # Args + Config
```
